pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with rounded vertices. Edge gradients are smooth and diffuse due to image blur. The spatial area of patches is dominant relative to the negative space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes consist of both tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. Pixel thickness of corridors is relatively narrow and consistent across the visible neck and shoulder.
